result.title: ProbFaS: Probabilistic Video Frame Selection for MLLMs via Multi-Fidelity Calibration
result.summary: Processing long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is prohibitively expensive, making informative frame selection essential for accurate video understanding. The default uniform sampling often misses task-relevant keyframes, while recent training-free selectors instead pick frames by how well each one matches the question under an image-text alignment (ITA) score. However, we show that ITA signals correspond poorly with the MLLM's true needs: their rankings correlate weakly with downstream accuracy and are even negatively correlated on over 40% of questions, whereas the MLLM's internal yes/no judgment yields a much stronger signal. We present ProbFaS, a training- and label-free probabilistic pipeline that fuses both signals for key frame selection. ProbFaS treats dense ITA scores as cheap, biased measurements and sparse MLLM judgments as accurate, costly ones, unifying them via co-kriging, a multi-fidelity Gaussian process, to calibrate relevance across all frames. A temporal determinantal point process then selects frames capturing relevance peaks while preserving temporal coverage. Across Video-MME, MLVU and LongVideoBench, ProbFaS is the most accurate among fourteen state-of-the-art training-free selectors and uniform sampling in 13 of 15 settings (8-128 frames), outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 3.1 percentage points. On MLVU and LongVideoBench, 32 ProbFaS frames match or surpass the top baseline at 128 frames and uniform sampling with up to 768 frames.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出图像-文本对齐（ITA）分数与 MLLM 真实需求相关性弱，提出免训练、免标注的 ProbFaS：用多保真度高斯过程（co-kriging）把稠密但有偏的 ITA 信号与稀疏但准确的 MLLM 是/否判断融合，再用时间 DPP 选出兼顾相关峰值与时间覆盖的关键帧。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「廉价有偏代理信号 + 昂贵准确判断」的校准框架与视觉证据筛选、以及 LOOK 环节看哪里、看多少的成本收益权衡直接相关；文中对选择信号与下游准确率相关性的分析可供核查 LVR 的证据选择与计算分配设计。
